setup.name: Forum name
setup.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown at the top of the forum and on Google.
setup.announceHint: The bot posts the title and link of every topic opened on the site.
setup.publishedHint: When off, the site responds that the page doesn't exist. Nothing is deleted.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: They become filters at the top of the forum. Whoever opens a topic picks one.
categories.deleteDescription: Its topics stay in the forum, without a category.

topics.blockDescription: They can no longer open topics or reply in this forum. What they already wrote stays up.
topics.newest: {count, plural, one {The # newest topic.} other {The # newest topics.}}

blocks.empty: No one is blocked. To block someone, open their topic in Topics.

intro.title: A public forum for your community
intro.site: Members open topics and reply on the site, signing in with Discord or Google. Everything shows up on Google, so a question answered once helps whoever comes later.
intro.discord: On Discord, whoever wrote a message can take it to the forum: right-click the message, Apps, Post to forum.
